title: Share the Truth
verse: Then Joshua read aloud all the words of the law, including the blessings and the curses, just as they are written in the law scroll. Joshua read aloud every commandment Moses had given before the whole assembly of Israel, including the women, children, and resident foreigners who lived among them.
observation: Joshua took time not to say, “Just trust me,” but shared the truth of God’s Word with others. As Christians, we must be careful to center our lives on God’s Word and then share God’s Word with others so they can, too. When we share God’s Word with others, people can experience the same life-changing experiences that we have found. Never be afraid to share God’s Word with everyone at all ages. God’s Word is what changes hearts.
application: Create a meeting where you can share God’s Word back and forth with someone else. Watch how the power of God’s Word will grow you both.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for sharing Your Word with us.
